The world's first hypersonic airliner blasts off from the U.S. to Australia. But a freak accident forces the plane into outer space! With time running out, the experts have only one last option to save the passengers: the Space Shuttle Columbia!

In this second sequel to the 1987 hit, RoboCop leaves the force and joins the rebellion to battle the evil business corporation OCP, which uses a police-like group to remove the homeless people who populate the site of a future upscale development.

Donald Sutherland stars in this moody thriller as a villainous Nazi spy whose passions betray him via a married woman (Kate Nelligan) in this intriguing blend of romance and espionage against the backdrop of WWII Britain.
